strings.zh: 奇怪？听不大清楚,{NEWLINE}电话坏了么？{SCROLL}你换个地方再打试试！
strings.en: Hello? Hello? Hello? Hello?{NEWLINE}...I think we have a bad connection.{SCROLL}Could you try again from another spot?

strings.zh: 喂喂⋯⋯{NEWLINE}你最近怎么样？{CLEAR}我身体很好。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Nice to hear from you.{NEWLINE}How is everything with you?{CLEAR}I’m good.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 除了我之外还有很多的{NEWLINE}道馆馆主,{CLEAR}你要一个个打倒他们啊！
strings.en: There are plenty of Gym Leaders besides{NEWLINE}me. Beat every last one of them!

strings.zh: 对了⋯⋯{NEWLINE}想要和我再战斗的话,{CLEAR}可以在星期五的晚上{SCROLL}打电话给我！
strings.en: Oh, right...{SCROLL}If you want to battle me again, you can{NEWLINE}call me on Friday nights!
strings.notes: US 0649/4 | RV070: addition: US added reluctance and maybe I will answer (D-1915)

strings.zh: 你这电话来的真是时候！{SCROLL}让我们再来对战一场吧？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Well, well, you called at the right time!{NEWLINE}You want to battle again?{SCROLL}I’m up for it.{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 呵呵呵,{NEWLINE}你的冲劲值得赞扬。{SCROLL}我在战斗前线的训练家屋等你哦！
strings.en: Ha ha ha. Your drive deserves praise.{SCROLL}I’ll be waiting for you at the Trainer{NEWLINE}House at the Battle Frontier!
strings.notes: US 0649/6 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 搞什么啊！{NEWLINE}你还想让我出丑吗？
strings.en: What’s the big idea?! You want to make{NEWLINE}me look like a fool again?
strings.notes: US 0649/7 | RV070: meaning: zh: make me lose face again

strings.zh: 这么想和我对战吗？{SCROLL}可是⋯⋯你现在{NEWLINE}有着闲工夫吗？{SCROLL}先去完成其他的人的预约吧。
strings.en: You want to battle me that badly?{SCROLL}But... do you even have the free time{NEWLINE}right now?{SCROLL}Go take care of your appointments with{NEWLINE}other people first.
strings.notes: US 0649/8 | RV070: meaning: zh: plain challenge; US verbose additions

strings.zh: 我在战斗前线的训练家屋{NEWLINE}等你⋯⋯{CLEAR}你可别放我鸽子啊。
strings.en: I’m waiting for you at the Trainer{NEWLINE}House at the Battle Frontier...{CLEAR}Don’t you dare stand me up.
strings.notes: US 0649/9 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.en: Yes, it’s Clair here...{NEWLINE}Oh, hi. How are you doing?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 我们约好了在战斗前线的{NEWLINE}训练家屋对战的,{CLEAR}不要忘了啊,{CLEAR}我等你⋯⋯
strings.en: Don’t forget, we promised to{NEWLINE}battle at the Trainer House at{CLEAR}the Battle Frontier. I’m waiting...
strings.notes: US 0649/11 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 这几天电台的人来我这{NEWLINE}说是要采访我做一个{CLEAR}专题⋯⋯{SCROLL}这个世界上,{NEWLINE}美人就是给人看的。{SCROLL}啊！可是广播的话{NEWLINE}不就不能看到{CLEAR}我的美貌了！{SCROLL}电视台是怎么了啊！{NEWLINE}电视台的人怎么不来啊！
strings.en: Lately some people from the radio{NEWLINE}station came by, saying they want to{CLEAR}interview me for a special feature...{SCROLL}In this world, beauty is meant to{NEWLINE}be seen.{SCROLL}Oh! But on the radio, nobody will be{NEWLINE}able to see my gorgeous looks!{SCROLL}What’s wrong with the TV stations?! Why{NEWLINE}haven’t the TV people come?!
strings.notes: US 0649/12 | RV070: meaning: zh: beauty is to be seen; US fans watching, confused

strings.zh: 最近我这最先端的时尚{CLEAR}成为了小镇上的传说。{SCROLL}这样就能传说,{NEWLINE}我也能理解那些{CLEAR}讨论这话题的人的想法了。
strings.en: Lately there seems to be some gossip{NEWLINE}running through town that I am the{CLEAR}latest name in fashion.{SCROLL}Well, if I’m that cool that people can’t{NEWLINE}stop talking about me, I can totally{CLEAR}understand that sentiment.

strings.zh: 看来你现在也是非常忙啊。{CLEAR}我这边也是。{SCROLL}又要忙道馆的工作,{NEWLINE}龙之使者们{CLEAR}还都想来祠堂的长老那里{CLEAR}露露脸。{SCROLL}你怎么样？{NEWLINE}既然你有实力,{CLEAR}那也向着龙之使者前进吧？
strings.en: Looks like you’re really busy these{NEWLINE}days too. So am I.{SCROLL}On top of my Gym work, the Dragon{NEWLINE}Tamers all want to come and show their{CLEAR}faces to the Elder at the shrine.{SCROLL}What about you?{SCROLL}You’ve got the skill, so why not aim to{NEWLINE}become a Dragon Tamer too?
strings.notes: US 0649/14 | RV070: meaning: zh: Dragon Tamers visit the Elder; US Clair visits; even busier (D-1915)
